messages.subject: Re: Jackknife test and Permutation Importance on enviro data
parts:
Hi Dimitris,

This option is not available on Wallace. Although once you build your model with the Rmarkdown, you can use the ENMeval::var.importance() function to get percent contribution and permutation importance.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject: Re: Jackknife test and Permutation Importance on enviro data
parts:
Hi Dimitris,

You can use the following line of code after line 162 in your markdown:
> var.importance(evalMods[["LQH_1"]])

You can change "LQH_1" for whatever model that you want.

Let me know if the info that I provided was helpful.

Best,
Gonzalo
